The season was scheduled to commence on 20 October 2023 and ends on 30 June 2024.{{cite web|title=V-League 2023-2024 bao giờ khởi tranh, có gì đặc biệt?|url=https://thethao247.vn/73-v-league-2023-2024-bao-gio-khoi-tranh-co-gi-dac-biet-d296087.html|website=thethao247.vn|lang=vi|access-date=28 August 2023}} [[Cong An Hanoi FC|Cong An Hanoi]] was the defending champions.{{cite web |title=CAHN vô địch V-League 2023 |trans-title=CAHN won the V.League 2023 |url=https://vnexpress.net/cahn-vs-thanh-hoa-4646598-tong-thuat.html |publisher=VnExpress |access-date=12 January 2024 |language=vi}} This season was the first since the [[2001–02 V-League|2001–02 season]] to have an inter-year schedule (autumn-to-spring) instead of an intra-year schedule (spring-to-autumn) to follow the schedule changes in the [[Asian Football Confederation|AFC]] competitions. There was also a break from 25 December 2023 to 10 February 2024 for the [[2023 AFC Asian Cup]] and from 7 April 2024 to 3 May 2024 for the [[2024 AFC U-23 Asian Cup]]. This was the first season that the league officially applies [[video assistant referee]] (VAR) technology, but will only apply to matches taking place in the north of the country.{{cite web|title=Bóng đá Việt Nam thay đổi ra sao nếu áp dụng VAR?|url=https://vtc.vn/bong-da-viet-nam-thay-doi-ra-sao-neu-ap-dung-var-ar800850.html|publisher=VTC News|access-date=28 August 2023|lang=vi}} Like the previous season, teams was allotted a non-naturalized Vietnamese player slot that will not be counted towards their foreign player allotment. ==Teams== A total of 14 teams will participate in the 2023 edition of the V.League 1. ===Changes from previous season=== {| class="wikitable" |- !
